filters.untrackedInRev: A commit snapshot has no untracked files.
filters.commitsHint: Searches a commit's title and description, and hash prefixes, back through history from the selected revision.

origin.loading: Looking for the commit that brought this into the line…
origin.boundary: The clone's history is cut before:
origin.boundaryHint: The clone is shallow: the substring may be older than this commit.
origin.limit: The walk stopped early — out of steps or time, or a version of the file is not text; the substring is in every version walked, the oldest:
origin.added: The line has no earlier version: this commit added it — or moved it from somewhere that could not be found.
origin.notInLine: The line no longer contains the substring — the file changed after the search.
origin.timeout: Ran out of time — the line's history is too long.
origin.failed: Could not trace the line's history.

truncated.files: Not every match is shown: the file search stopped at its limit. Refine the query or narrow the path.
truncated.chats: Not every message is shown: the search scans only the most recent matches. Refine the query.

empty.noQuery: Type a query in the search box above.

error.badFilter: The search was rejected: check the regular expression, path and revision.
error.timeout: The file search did not finish in time. Refine the query or narrow the path.
